name: Ikenie no Yousei
source:
Myril is a fairy who gained a human body by magic to train herself in the human world.
She planned to make the humans' wishes come true then go back to her world.
However, she is trapped by lustful human beings and gets captured by a huge tentacle creature...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE064822.html]DLsite English[/url]]
